question: Which of the following devices is based on the phenomenon of electromagnetic induction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Generator**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electromagnetic induction **

 
 
• **It was first discovered by Faraday’s, therefore, it is also known as Faraday’s laws of electromagnetic induction.**
 
• We know, **the generator basic principle of operation, is electromagnetic induction. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• When a change in flux linkages is changed, an emf or voltage is induced, thus we get voltage and hence current as our output which is desired for generators.
 
• We know, in generators, the input is mechanical and the output is electrical.
 
• So, with this change in the magnetic field, we get an induced emf and hence current.
 
• **The mechanical force is used to bring in the changes in magnetic flux which in turn produces electricity.**
